tier1.text: Each psoas major is a muscle that flexes, or bends, the hip joint. With the iliacus muscle, it forms the iliopsoas group, which also bends the trunk at the hip. It runs from the lower spine to the femur, or thigh bone. It also helps form the back wall of the abdomen.

sentences.text: Each psoas major is a muscle that flexes, or bends, the hip joint.

quotes.quote: A striated muscle located in the iliac region that originates both on the transverse processes of the twelfth thoracic through fifth lumbar vertebrae and the lateral aspects of the discs between them, and inserts on the lesser trochanter of the femur; it functions to flex the hip joint.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: flexion: movement in the sagittal plane that decreases the angle of a joint (bends the joint)
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: With the iliacus muscle, it forms the iliopsoas group, which also bends the trunk at the hip.

quotes.quote: iliopsoas group: muscle group consisting of iliacus and psoas major muscles, that flexes the thigh at the hip, rotates it laterally, and flexes the trunk of the body onto the hip
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: It runs from the lower spine to the femur, or thigh bone.

quotes.quote: originates both on the transverse processes of the twelfth thoracic through fifth lumbar vertebrae and the lateral aspects of the discs between them, and inserts on the lesser trochanter of the femur
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: femur: thigh bone; the single bone of the thigh
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: It also helps form the back wall of the abdomen.

quotes.quote: The posterior abdominal wall is formed by the lumbar vertebrae, parts of the ilia of the hip bones, psoas major and iliacus muscles, and quadratus lumborum muscle.
